decision.selected_method: direct legal generation within frozen FamilySpace

input.hypothesis: A two-segment continuum with four equally spaced tendons spanning both segments is a legal symmetric structure in the frozen family and can be generated as an owned candidate; its reach-and-hold performance remains unmeasured.
input.expected_observation: Generation returns one owned candidate that passes structural and schema validity checks, while candidate status still shows no mathematical or physical task evaluation and no established task pass.
input.weakening_observation: Generation is rejected as structurally or schematically invalid, or no owned candidate is created.
input.fixed_conditions: Keep all frozen defaults and prototypes unchanged except the declared segment count, tendon count, and one equal-spacing tendon span over segments 0 through 1; perform no mathematical, control, RL, or physical evaluation.
input.stopping_condition: After observing whether generation creates a legal owned candidate, retrieve the complete fresh-result index using the advertised working-set query and then STOP without evaluating task performance.
input.interpretation: A successful generation establishes only legality and ownership of an unmeasured design. It does not establish reachability, holding performance, task acceptance, hardware performance, or optimality.
